environment.description: Service deployed on EKS cluster behind internal NLB (scheme: internal). Upstream traffic is routed through an envoy sidecar with ext_authz disabled for health checks only. The NLB target group has a preserved client IP configuration with proxy protocol v2 enabled. Security group sg-0a3f8e2c1b (attached to NLB ENIs) has inbound rules restricted to CIDR blocks 10.128.0.0/16 (internal VPC), 172.20.0.0/14 (peered services VPC), and 192.168.100.0/24 (VPN egress). No internet gateway route exists in the subnet route table (rtb-07d4a2e9f1) associated with the NLB subnets. The Kafka cluster uses mTLS with certificate-based ACLs: only CN=price-feed-producer.internal is granted WRITE on topic 'product.price.updates'. Pod network policy (Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-external-ingress') restricts pod ingress to source IPs matching the NLB health check range and the NLB's private IPs only.
